messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up1: ran a quick audit after CS noticed several mid-enterprise customers dropped to 'High Renewal Risk' overnight. Looks systemic, not manual.
Liam O'Rourke: saw that. spikes in the risk bucket around 02:00 UTC. cs-ops-bot alerted at 02:05.
cs-ops-bot: [ALERT] healthscore:renewal-risk	62 accounts flagged in 5m (baseline ~12). Batch scorer v3.4.1 ran at 02:00 UTC.
Noah Graham: initial blink: the scorer treats last_active = NULL as 0 recency, but our events pipeline recently changed event timestamps to use event_time instead of created_at for archived events. backfill lag means many recent acts != reflected.
Zara Patel: so null last_active -> older -> higher risk. can we backfill last_active from events table and re-run? we should pause outbound renewal nudges until corrected.
Maya Chen: pausing renewal-nudge campaign now: /campaign pause renewal-nudge --scope enterprise --reason "scorer drift"
cs-ops-bot: [ACTION] campaign:renewal-nudge paused by Maya Chen at 02:12 UTC.
Liam O'Rourke: quick SQL I ran to validate: ```sql SELECT a.account_id, a.last_active, max(e.event_time) as inferred_last_active FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id HAVING a.last_active IS NULL AND max(e.event_time) > now() - interval '90 days' LIMIT 20;``` returned 58 enterprise accounts.
Noah Graham: I'm prepping an idempotent backfill job: ```python scripts/backfill_last_active.py --since 2026-02-01 --dry-run``` will write to a temp table and emit a report.
Zara Patel: also worth adding a safety guard in the scorer: if last_active IS NULL and inferred_last_active > 0 then use inferred, else skip scoring and flag for manual review. small change but avoids mass false positives.
Liam O'Rourke: agreed. I'll open a tiny PR with the guard + unit test. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/cs/healthscore/pulls/301 (WIP).
Maya Chen: Noah, run the dry-run and post the CSV to /mnt/csops/backfills/4332112345-inferred.csv so CS leads can preview.
Noah Graham: done. dry-run shows 58 affected. sample: ent_acct_1004 (ops@starkpower.com) inferred_last_active=2026-03-18T16:22:11Z
cs-ops-bot: [NOTE] Backfill dry-run produced 58 rows. artifacts: /mnt/csops/backfills/4332112345-inferred.csv
Zara Patel: after backfill, re-run scorer in staging with a replay window and confirm risk buckets return to baseline before unpausing nudges. Also file an ops dashboard alert: "healthscore:rule-drift" with a delta threshold 3x baseline.
Liam O'Rourke: patch merged to staging branch. running backfill job in staging now: ```kubectl exec -c migrator backfill-job -- python scripts/backfill_last_active.py --run``` ETA 6m.
Maya Chen: heads-up for comms: we'll tell customers who got premature risk emails that it was an internal scoring bug, apologize, and retract automated asks. Priya (CS lead) to draft a short template.
Noah Graham: staging backfill finished. report: 58 updated, idempotent update statement used: ```UPDATE accounts SET last_active = inferred.last_active FROM inferred WHERE accounts.account_id = inferred.account_id AND (accounts.last_active IS NULL OR accounts.last_active < inferred.last_active);```
cs-ops-bot: [DEPLOY] scorer v3.4.2-staging with guard applied deployed at 02:34 UTC.
Liam O'Rourke: re-run scorer replay in staging: output risk flags back to expected distribution. baseline comparison passed (p-value > 0.05 against control window).
Zara Patel: ok to roll to prod after a quick canary: will run scorer on 5% sample.
Maya Chen: canary result good. /campaign resume renewal-nudge --scope enterprise --reason "false positives remediated"
cs-ops-bot: [ACTION] campaign:renewal-nudge resumed by Maya Chen at 02:49 UTC.
Liam O'Rourke: follow-ups: 1) make inferred_last_active backfill part of the nightly ETL for 14 days, 2) add test in event pipeline PRs to ensure event_time migrates with archived events, 3) dashboard ticket RED-CS-911 created for rule-drift alert.
Noah Graham: will drop a short runbook note under CS-runbooks: "healthscore null-last_active triage" with commands and links to backfill artifacts.
Zara Patel: thanks team. Priya will send a short customer note and CS leads are looped in. closing the blast, will watch metrics for 24h.
Maya Chen: excellent work. tagging @cs-ops-bot for audit and will attach the post-action checklist to the incident thread. :white_check_mark:
